author: JaySun1885
title: Would have given ZERO stars
review:
I’ve used GP for many years, always loved it. I’ve worked around many of its quirky features over the years, but now im done with it. I’ll be moving all of my photos out and cancelling my subscription. 

I understand there are good reasons for managing space on my phone, stored in GP, clear space on your phone. I get it. 

How about this, GIVE ME THE OPTION OF DECIDING IF I WANT TO DELETE EVERY COPY FROM ALL DEVICES AND OTHER CLOUD SERVICES??!!

I have more than one GP account as I use Google to have my business account too. 
Can I stop my personal photos appearing in my Business Photos??? 
NO I CANT - because it gives GP access to every single area of my accounts to import every photo regardless if I want my business account to have them or not. 
If I choose to stop syncing - guess what, it stops syncing FOR MY PERSONAL GMAIL TOO!!! 

So it’s either all or nothing. Either I allow all photos to sync to my personal Gmail and work Gmail or I turn off syncing. 
And if I have the temerity to want to delete my PERSONAL photos from my work Gmail, IT WANTS TO DELETE MY PERSONAL PHOTO FROM EVERYWHERE!!!!

Google, I’ve been with you for many years. 
Why are you so jealous of me having photos that I don’t share with you? 
Why do you take away my choice of where I want to store photos? 

You make it either all or nothing. 

I’m now choosing nothing.

author: Alexander.V.V.
title: Big potential but poor execution
review:
A lot of UX design errors. Some of them are really annoying. Upload: 1. Need a retry button if something goes wrong with cloud upload. 2. Show upload progress for each item. 3. Allow to optionay see upload speed. 4. Be a lot more descriptive about errors! Because most of them are triggered by connection issues Iike network switching you can predict the most probable with AI. Actually I still do not get why you not using ML to improve UX of errors.. 5. Allow prioritizing upload. The use case is simple - I travel as a tourist, shoot 4-5 videos, it starts syncing, I wanna share certain video with my parents, I'm stuck in waiting for all videos get uploaded.
Free up space: 1. Sometimes you don't delete local copies of videos. I think you have to implement a job system. User triggers a local copy deletion job and off error occured you repeat it in some time automatically. Now  Google Photos App thinks that it deleted certain videos/phos but it was not deleted eventually. So Google photo App library ends up out of sync with an actual iPhone state. That's very bad and looks like an amateur error.
Also I'm pretty sure that ty his concerns will not actually ever make it to the product team and thats another problem )

title: What’s the point?
review:
I genuinely don’t understand the point of Google Photos.

It mirrors everything in my Gallery, and when I delete photos from one to free up space, they also get deleted from the other.

So I either end up with a phone with full storage, or a backup that gets deleted when I delete what’s on my phone.

To fix this, I end up moving all my photos and videos to an external storage device, deleting everything from Google Photos, then putting everything back on my phone again. 
It’s such a tedious workaround for something that is supposed to make backing up photos easier.

Can someone explain how this is NOT just a duplicate app for my Gallery/Photos app?
